steps.what: Use remote sensing evidence to assess forest or carbon tracking implications

tasks.design: Retain scientific assessment in {OTHER}, the geospatial analysis system, with reasoning recorded in {DOCS}. Repeat processing belongs to the separate analysis task; no second saving is taken for interpreting its outputs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Observed canopy change does not directly establish cause or carbon impact.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing alerts can focus attention without determining environmental meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Seasonality, disturbance attribution and uncertain biomass assumptions.
tasks.human_edge: Explain the limits of the evidence and avoid unsupported carbon claims.
tasks.altitude: Environmental assessment time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Ecological context and ground validation limits

evidence.claim: Satelligence provides deforestation alerts and EUDR evidence; that does not establish automatic carbon assessment or this task's labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is application and interpretation for forest or carbon tracking, excluding separately counted processing and acquisition.
The scientist reviews observation provenance, dates, area, quality diagnostics and carbon assumptions during s1; no free deforestation-cause or valid-carbon-estimate flag is assumed.
Upstream analysis produces observations and diagnostics through its separately counted workflow; no new capture is transferred there.
Test existing geospatial views before custom work; zero upkeep because this proposal adds no tool or procedure.
unknowns: Forest context, carbon method and available ground evidence
research_questions: Which observed changes cannot support a defensible carbon interpretation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; application and interpretation remain, with no duplicate processing saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define image distortion mechanisms, correction requirements and independent validation examples
Develop correction routine code from the specified method

loop.purpose: Assist implementation of a scientist-defined correction method
loop.input: verified method, data schema and coding constraints
loop.output: code candidate with assumptions and tests
loop.check: Scientist checks algorithm fidelity, numerical meaning, treatment of vegetation and preservation of real signal against the specification
loop.stop: One revision then manual implementation if scientific meaning or behaviour remains wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: New method implementation has contextual code choices beyond an existing configured routine

steps.what: Test correction effectiveness and accept the exact routine version

tasks.design: Inspect existing correction functions in {OTHER}, the scientific development environment, before generating code. When a genuinely new routine is required, use a bounded implementation draft and retain independent scientific validation before internal acceptance.
tasks.previous_blocker: A new correction method requires implementation and domain-specific tests.
tasks.enabler_now: Code drafting can help translate an explicit method into a candidate routine.
tasks.still_hard: Removing distortion without deleting real environmental signal.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a defensible method and reject visually convincing but incorrect corrections.
tasks.altitude: Potentially less code typing; scientific design and validation remain intact.

evidence.claim: A bounded coding assistant may reduce implementation effort for an explicit scientific method; this capability application and saving are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is developing a routine, excluding later production execution and separately assessed environmental interpretation.

In s1 the scientist produces input schema, units, distortion hypothesis, algorithm equations, parameters, excluded conditions and independent validation cases. Full capture and scientific design remain; no free vegetation labels or correct-answer mask is assumed.
Reference observations must exist or be produced within the retained s1 effort; absent validation data stops assisted development and requires manual investigation.
Test native scientific functions first. The model drafts code only and cannot accept a method or deploy a production routine.
unknowns: Existing correction functions and independent reference quality
Actual code review and testing overhead
research_questions: Does assisted implementation save time after independent signal-preservation tests?

already_counted.description: Scientific specification, reference capture and independent testing

approvals.approved_version: Exact code, method, parameters, reference datasets and test results; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gross8 minus5 upkeep gives net3. Range0-1 allows review of subtle signal loss to absorb most implementation gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop new sensing techniques or systems

steps.what: Develop new analytical techniques or sensor systems through scientific design and experimentation

tasks.design: Retain original scientific development with the scientist using {OTHER}, the scientific design environment, and {DOCS}. Routine coding assistance belongs to a separately bounded implementation task and earns no second saving here.
tasks.previous_blocker: A new technique requires a testable hypothesis and evidence.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting and calculation tools do not establish a replacement for discovery.
tasks.still_hard: Novel measurement problems and unexpected experimental behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Choose useful questions and recognise when an apparent improvement is an artefact.
tasks.altitude: Scientific development time and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Original method and sensor development is scientific judgement; no generic administrative baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is original concept development and experimentation, excluding separate implementation and production analysis.
The scientist creates hypotheses, experimental design and interpretation during s1; no free structured valid-method or optimal-sensor flag is assumed.
Review existing scientific tools first; no added tool or process is proposed.
Zero upkeep follows from leaving the research workflow unchanged.
unknowns: Research question, sensor constraints and experiment resources
research_questions: What independent experiment could disprove the new technique's claimed benefit?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; original design and experimentation remain.

tasks.short: Apply sensing techniques to environmental issues

steps.what: Apply remote sensing findings and techniques to environmental issues and assess limitations

tasks.design: Retain environmental application and interpretation with the scientist in {OTHER}, the geospatial analysis system. Findings and limitations are recorded in {DOCS}; separate repeat-processing savings are not counted again.
tasks.previous_blocker: A computed feature is not automatically evidence of an environmental problem.
tasks.enabler_now: Reproducible processing supports assessment without deciding applicability.
tasks.still_hard: Attribution, local conditions and uncertainty in surface water or dust interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether the method addresses the environmental question at the required scale.
tasks.altitude: Environmental interpretation and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Applying computed sensing evidence to an environmental issue requires domain judgement; no additional processing saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific application after separately counted processing, excluding acquisition, production transforms and policy decisions.

Upstream analysis produces observations and diagnostics in its own counted workflow. The scientist checks context, assumptions and relevance in s1; no free confirmed-flood or valid-dust-source flag is assumed.
Test existing geospatial functionality before custom tools; none is added here.
Zero upkeep because no new method or system is proposed.
unknowns: Environmental question, local evidence and acceptable uncertainty
research_questions: Which independent observations would change the application assessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0; application judgement remains and computational savings belong to the separate analysis task.

reach: Collaborate with scientific software engineers on independent validation
